script: Why did Russell Westbrook walk past this kid asking for an autograph? NBA players are often warned about signing with blue pens because resellers can use those signatures to make copies with stamps. And Russ normally has no problem signing things for real fans. So when he ignored this kid, it seemed like he already knew what was going on.
